## Captain handoff

- [ ] Only this workstream's changes are committed; no private recordings/evidence.
- [ ] No shared checkout, shared installation, or other agent's work was altered.
- [ ] No merge, version bump, release tag, or publication was performed.
- [ ] Ready for review, not claimed integrated or released.
